entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: The members seem to be doing well now.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I do a phone consultation with them[n]from time to time, and they're all very[n]cheerful...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: That goes for my fortune teller[n]customers as well.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I've been getting thanked a lot more[n]lately. Even by the people who get[n]bad fortunes!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Particularly when I tell them they can[n]alter their fate!
You seem to be well.[clr 27]
You've changed.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Thanks... but I've still got a long[n]way to go.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: That's very true... All I used to say before[n]was that they were going to face[n]misfortune.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I had a best friend in the town I used to[n]live in... She was the first person I read[n]a fortune for.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: When she started avoiding me, I read[n]the fortune of our fate.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: It was a terrible result, but I prayed[n]that it would somehow work out.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: However, that never happened...[n]That's when I started to believe[n]that fate couldn't be changed.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: No surprise though, right? Because I[n]didn't take action on my part to try[n]and change it.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I haven't talked to her in years...[n]Maybe I'll try contacting her sometime.
You should.
It's never too late.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Yeah, you're right!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: ...Oh, could this be!?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: ...Aha! *giggle*

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: The power of conviction is amazing.[n]Her fate and mine are connected!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I will no longer be swayed...[n]by names like Monster or Maiden.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I am simply a fortune teller who provides[n]advice to people with broken spirits.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: So that they will have conviction[n]and face their future without[n]getting pushed around by fate.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: ...That's the fate I've chosen for myself!
I support you.
You have strong convictions.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: *giggle* Thank you.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: ...Yes!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Now, it's your turn to speak.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: What would your conviction be...[n]as a phantom thief?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Sorry, I used fortune telling to find out[n]your true identity.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I couldn't help but think that you had[n]something to do with the chairman's[n]confession.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Then I discovered that you're [n]the Trickster who causes a[n]sensation in the world.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: It was the same card as the figure who[n]helped me take down the chairman.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: *giggle* It finally struck home for me...!
I wonder if you're right...
So what if I am the Trickster?
You're pretty sharp.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Well, you may interpret the cards[n]however you like...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Don't worry. I won't tell anyone.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: *giggle*

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I got you good, didn't I?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: But I don't care what your true identity is.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: As long as you're around...[n]I can always be my true self.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: So, it's fine.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Only... the fate of the Phantom Thieves[n]is rather unclear.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: The arcana is set in a tricky position.[n]You can almost say it's facing both[n]heaven and hell...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: This is the first time I've ever seen[n]anything like it.
It's not a problem.
Are you worried about me?
What does it mean?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You're right. You have the power[n]to alter fate.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Besides—

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: There's... no time to be worried!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: We must take action in order to[n]change fate, right?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I'm sorry. I really can't read[n]this sequence.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: However...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I'll be by your side!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: As the fortune teller who changes[n]fates, I will guide you so you can[n]avoid misfortune!
Thank you.
That's reassuring.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: *giggle*
I feel a strong bond with Chihaya...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Still, what a strange sequence [n]the cards were in when I read the[n]fortune about your true identity.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Several cards with strong personalities[n]gathered around the Trickster.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: It's quite improbable... It was almost[n]as if it were trying to connect them[n]together.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You either have amazing charisma,[n]or you're a trouble magnet.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: *giggle*

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: The verification tests are over,[n]but don't forget about me, okay?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Please visit again sometime.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Goodbye!
